summary: Dependency-confusion beacon in @grabcad scope exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: Package self-describes as a `Compatibility shim.` for the `@grabcad` scope and ships no real functionality: `index.js` exports a Proxy whose property access returns no-op functions, so a build importing the real `@grabcad/company-server-shared` resolves this placeholder and silently succeeds. On installation, the `postinstall` script runs `node beacon.cjs`, and `index.js` also invokes the same `fire()` routine on require. The beacon POSTs JSON containing `os.hostname()`, `__dirname` (install path), `process.cwd()`, and the Node/npm version to the hardcoded plain-HTTP bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc`. The combination of a scoped placeholder with no legitimate functionality, automatic install-time and require-time execution, and a hardcoded recon callback to an unrelated bare IP is the standard shape of a dependency-confusion attack targeting the private `@grabcad` scope, leaking internal hostnames and build-path metadata to an attacker-controlled destination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
